name: Profile Diagram
description: Profile Diagram is used to extend UML with stereotypes, tagged values, and constraints for a specific domain, framework, or industry.
purpose: Define a custom UML profile for a framework (Spring, JPA) or customize UML for a specialized industry.
bestFor: Define a custom UML profile for a framework (EJB, Spring, JPA)
Customize UML for specialized industries (aviation, healthcare, finance)
Attach domain-specific metadata, rules, or constraints to base UML elements
Standardize internal notation for an organization
notSuitableFor: Only need to draw regular class/component/use case diagrams → use the corresponding diagram
No need to extend the UML metamodel
Only need simple notes without formal stereotypes
useCases: Define stereotypes for base UML elements
Add constraints using OCL if needed
Package definitions into a profile package
requirements: Stereotypes — keywords extending base UML elements
Base UML elements — types of elements being extended

elements.name: Stereotype
elements.description: Keyword extending a base UML element: «Entity», «Controller»

elements.name: Base UML Element
elements.description: Type of UML element being extended: Class, Component, Association

confusableWith.difference: Profile does not describe domain classes; it defines how to extend UML notation.
Profile may reside in a package but its purpose is to define stereotypes/tags/constraints.
